panel.name: wolf_update_notice
panel.panel.string: Update now downloads it ([SIZE] MB) and installs it. Windows will ask for permission, then WolfViewer starts again. Your settings and saved logins are kept.
Update now downloads it ([SIZE] MB), puts it in place and starts WolfViewer again. Your settings and saved logins are kept.
Update now downloads it ([SIZE] MB) and opens it in Finder, ready to drag into Applications. Your settings and saved logins are kept.
You installed WolfViewer from the Wolf Territories package repository, so your system's software updater will offer it with your other updates.
WolfViewer is installed in [DIR], which your account cannot change, so it cannot update itself. Open the download page to get the new version.
This can take a few minutes. You can log in while you wait; WolfViewer will ask you before it restarts.
Windows will ask for permission. WolfViewer will then close and start again by itself.
WolfViewer will close and start again by itself.
Opening the new WolfViewer in Finder.
Drag WolfViewer onto Applications and choose Replace, then quit WolfViewer and start it again. Your settings and saved logins are kept.

button.name: not_now_btn
button.label: Not now
button.tool_tip: Do not remind me about this version. You will be told when the next one is ready.
